# Vincent Iwuno (0xVince)

Cybersecurity researcher and penetration tester from Nigeria. Specializes in offensive security, CTF competitions, network infrastructure, and security tooling. Builds real-world infrastructure projects including SMTP mail servers with SPF/DKIM/DMARC, phishing awareness labs with GoPhish, and network reconnaissance automation. Active on TryHackMe, HackTheBox, and HackerDNA. Open to security roles, freelance pentesting, and CTF collaborations.

## What I Do

- Penetration testing and vulnerability research
- Network security infrastructure (Postfix, DNS, firewall rules)
- Security tooling (Python, Bash, Nmap automation)
- CTF competitions (web exploitation, privilege escalation, forensics, crypto)
- Reverse engineering (GDB, Ghidra, binary exploitation)

## Key Projects

- Custom SMTP Mail Server — Postfix + Brevo with full email authentication
- Phishing Awareness Lab — GoPhish deployment for security training
- Network Recon Automation — Nmap wrapper with automated reporting
- SecureOps MCP — LLM-driven local security auditing server
